english: This notice explains the internal graduate regulations (내규, internal rules) of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부).
Decision of the department's Academic Affairs Committee (학사위원회) on 24 May 2023 (Wed)
Doctoral degree requirements – whether co-first authorship (공동1저자, shared first authorship) is recognised
※ This does not apply to master's students (co-first authorship is not recognised for the master's degree).
[Excerpt from the regulations on doctoral degree requirements]
B. Degree requirements
(1) Omitted
(2) Both conditions ① and ② below must be met. Only papers or patents that include the academic advisor's name as a co-author,
and in which the student's name is listed first among the authors other than the advisor, are recognised.
① The student must publish at least 1 paper in an internationally recognised journal (hereafter 'international journal').
② The student must also have at least 1 of the following: 1 paper presented at an international conference, or 1 paper published in a domestic (Korean) journal, or 1 registered international patent.
B. (2) Whether co-first authorship is recognised
➀ Degree candidate + postdoctoral researcher (포닥) in the same lab
➁ Degree candidate + degree candidate from another department or another university
➂ Degree candidates within the same lab
→ The credit is divided as 1/N, where N is the number of all co-first authors, not counting the advisor.
* For co-first authorship, the work is recognised even if the student's name is not listed first.
* The paper must include a statement that the authors are co-first authors.
(Example statement: ~ contributed equally to this work.)
Example)
If a full requirement counts as 1 point, submitting a paper as sole first author counts as 1 point.
1) If the student has 3 papers, each with 3 co-first authors:
0.33+0.33+0.33=0.99 → rounded to 1, so the requirement is recognised as met.
2) If the student has 1 paper with 3 co-first authors and 1 paper with 2 co-first authors:
The student must submit 1 more paper.
